cta_caption: Comment LIMITS aur main full guide DM kar dunga 📩

slides.headline: RULE 1: [7 DIN]
slides.label: COMMENTS
lines: Har comment pe **ek private reply**, comment ke **7 din** ke andar.

slides.headline: RULE 2: [24 GHANTE]
slides.label: CHATS
lines: Kisi ne message kiya? Unke last message se **24 ghante** tak reply karo.

slides.headline: RULE 3: [HOURLY] CAP
slides.label: LIMIT
lines: Har account ki **hourly limit** hai. **Viral reels** isse hit kar sakti hain.

slides.headline: SABKO DM? [NAHI]
slides.label: IN PRACTICE
lines: Saare followers ko ek saath DM **nahi** kar sakte. Sirf last **24 ghante** ke chats.

slides.headline: DM [NAHI] PAHUNCHA?
slides.label: WHY
lines: Comment **7 din** se purana, chat **refuse**, ya **hourly limit** hit.
